## Pathogen briefing — Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus
Intrinsic features: gram-positive cocci, low-affinity PBP2a (mecA), biofilm-forming on hardware
Resistance genes (4):
  - mecA / PBP2a: affects all_beta_lactams_except_anti_MRSA_cephs
  - Erm A/B/C: affects macrolides, lincosamides, streptogramin_B
  - tetK / tet(M): affects tetracyclines (susceptible to tigecycline + eravacycline)
  - blaZ / penicillinase: affects penicillin_G
First-line therapy: vancomycin AUC 400-600, daptomycin 8-12 mg/kg, linezolid (preferred for pneumonia)
Clinical context: mecA/PBP2a is the defining feature. Ceftaroline is the only cephalosporin active vs MRSA via allosteric PBP2a binding.
Design a candidate against MRSA. Cite at least one resistance gene from the briefing.

Anchoring on daptomycin_core — its mechanism survives the dominant resistance pathways listed above.

PROPOSAL: CCCCCCCCCC(=O)NC(CC(=O)N)C(=O)NC(C(=O)O)C(C)O
RATIONALE: The briefing flags resistance genes that target the daptomycin_core class — chose a derivative that retains the active-site geometry while shifting the polarity profile, reducing efflux susceptibility commonly seen in MRSA.

Resistance genes (6):
  - vanA operon (Tn1546): affects vancomycin, teicoplanin
  - vanB operon: affects vancomycin (teicoplanin partial)
  - PBP5 of E. faecium: affects ampicillin, penicillin
  - Erm B: affects macrolides, lincosamides
  - cfr methyltransferase: affects linezolid (PhLOPSa cross-resistance)
  - aac(6')-Ie-aph(2''): affects high-level gentamicin (HLAR)
First-line therapy: daptomycin 10-12 mg/kg (bactericidal), linezolid 600 mg q12h (bacteriostatic but oral), tedizolid (cfr-positive partial rescue)
Clinical context: vanA Tn1546 D-Ala-D-Lac substitution. cfr methylation is the rising linezolid-resistance threat (PhLOPSa cross-resistance).

Resistance genes (4):
  - penA mosaic genes: affects ceftriaxone (XDR strains)
  - gyrA S91F + parC S87R: affects fluoroquinolones
  - 23S rRNA A2058G/A2059G: affects azithromycin
  - mtrR mutations: affects macrolides, azoles
First-line therapy: ceftriaxone 500 mg IM x 1 (CDC 2021), gepotidacin (novel target, FQ-R + CRO-R rescue), azithromycin (deprioritized — rising R)
Clinical context: penA mosaic genes + 23S rRNA mutations. XDR strains require novel-target NBTIs (gepotidacin, zoliflodacin).
Design a candidate against NGono. Cite at least one resistance gene from the briefing.

Anchoring on zoliflodacin — its mechanism survives the dominant resistance pathways listed above.
